Emma L: heads up — noticed a batch import last night cleared some owner ids for ~3.2k accounts. we should run a quick ownership snapshot + telemetry check before any playbooks fire. unsure if it affected healthscore fields too :grimace:
Raj P: ugh. which import? the salesforce delta?
Emma L: yep, looks like the SFDC delta job (job id 2026-08-03-delta). index mapping mismatch — `owner_id` -> `owner` in the payload. import logic set empty string, then nullified canonical owner.
Maria C: can we do a narrow repair first? i.e., only accounts with last_modified < job_ts and with a non-null previous_owner in audit_logs. minimize churn.
Raj P: good call. i sketched a query to identify affected rows and a safe update pattern:

```sql
-- identify candidates
SELECT a.account_id
FROM accounts a
JOIN audit_logs al ON al.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE al.event = 'owner_changed'
  AND al.payload->>'previous_owner' IS NOT NULL
  AND a.owner_id IS NULL
  AND a.last_modified < '2026-08-03T02:00:00Z'
LIMIT 10000;

-- safe update (example)
UPDATE accounts a
SET owner_id = al.payload->>'previous_owner', metadata = jsonb_set(a.metadata, '{repair_by}', '"emma/repair-2026-08-03"')
FROM (
  SELECT account_id, payload
  FROM audit_logs
  WHERE event = 'owner_changed' AND payload->>'previous_owner' IS NOT NULL
) al
WHERE a.account_id = al.account_id
  AND a.owner_id IS NULL
  AND a.last_modified < '2026-08-03T02:00:00Z'
LIMIT 1000; -- batch
```

Emma L: that looks safe. can we also capture healthscore delta before/after for a sample set? i want to make sure the health scoring didn't get recomputed to a worse value after owner cleared.
Oliver M: yep — we have a small job to snapshot score history. i'll run a dry-scan against the affected set and output a CSV with columns (account_id, score_before, score_after_estimate, last_touch_ts).
Maria C: for playbooks: freeze outbound nudges for these accounts until we've confirmed owner assignments. otherwise customers might get orphaned nudge flows.
Emma L: agreed. @cs-bot can you pause playbook-wf on tag `import-2026-08-03`?
cs-bot: pausing playbooks matching tag `import-2026-08-03`... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
cs-bot: done — 3 playbooks paused (nudge-trial, onboarding-ps-firstweek, renewal-checkin). run id: pb-pause-1749055568 :white_check_mark:
Raj P: i'll run the identification query and push first safe batch at 1749055600. will monitor logs and perf.
Emma L: thanks. leave a rollback step in the pr — revert to previous owner_id = NULL and remove repair_by metadata if needed.
Maria C: once repaired, i'll trigger a targeted sampling run to validate healthscore and enable playbooks with a controlled ramp (5% -> 25% -> 100%).
Oliver M: export path: s3://redwood-cs/repairs/2026-08-03-ownership-snapshot.csv. i'll upload scan results there within 15m.
Raj P: ran first batch (1k). logs: `repaired=1000 skipped=12 errors=0`. pushing next. will keep batches <=1k.
Emma L: awesome. keeping this thread as the canonical audit note. pls paste PR link and rollback steps when done. thanks all :pray:
Raj P: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cs-admin/pull/412 — includes SQL, idempotency checks, and a smoke test. rollback instructions in PR description.
Maria C: reminder: update the playbook automation rule that triggers on `owner_changed` events — there was an edge case where empty-string owners count as changed. patch in the PR to filter `owner IS NULL OR owner = ''` before triggering.
Emma L: perfect. after Oliver uploads the snapshot i'll unpause playbooks incrementally and watch the first cohort.
cs-bot: job report uploaded: s3://redwood-cs/repairs/2026-08-03-ownership-snapshot.csv (rows=3200). :file_folder:
Oliver M: uploaded and shared with cs-ops folder. sample diff shows median health delta = -0.0 (no change), 95th percentile change = -0.03. looks safe to unfreeze.
Emma L: ok i'll unpause nudge-trial for 5% and monitor for 2h, then ramp. thanks team. :tada:
